integrity_statement: The all-size proof is the finite 21-support-state transition certificate plus exact surjective-labelling weights. Direct tests are supplementary and do not substitute for the infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for deterministic synchronous three-color inhibitory firefly dynamics on labelled stars only; no claim for general trees, asynchronous or stochastic processes, or more colors. Earlier unindexed equivalent classification cannot be excluded.
title: Exact seven-layer synchronization census for three-color firefly stars
